_**Agent (claude-opus-4-5-20251101 2026-01-11T02:17:25.645Z)**_

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Both functions are fixed. The issue was that WordPress's `apply_filters` can pass the default value to filter callbacks, and if the filter was initialized with an empty string (or if another plugin returned a non-array value), the `array_merge()` call would fail.

Now the code properly checks if `$variables` is an array before attempting to merge, and initializes it as an empty array if it's not.

The user should now be able to copy the updated file to their WordPress installation or rebuild the plugin.
</details></think>

_**Agent (claude-opus-4-5-20251101 2026-01-11T02:17:26.914Z)**_

Fixed. The problem was that the `greenshift_global_variables` filter was passing an empty string instead of an array. Both filter callbacks now check if `$variables` is an array and initialize it as empty array if not.

Copy the updated `includes/tokens.php` to your WordPress installation or sync the plugin files to test.

     1→# Greenlight Addon - WordPress Gutenberg Block Extension
     2→
     3→A powerful WordPress plugin that extends Gutenberg blocks with Greenlight's high-quality library of components. This addon provides advanced styling, animation, interactions, dynamic placeholders and class system and customization capabilities for WordPress block development on top of Greenshift or GreenLight PRO plugins. 
     4→
     5→## 🚀 Features
     6→
     7→- **Advanced Block Styling**: Dynamic CSS generation with device-specific responsive controls
     8→- **Class System**: AOS (Animate On Scroll) animations with interaction layers
     9→- **Animation Support**: AOS (Animate On Scroll) animations with interaction layers
    10→- **Rich Text Editing**: Enhanced text editing with RichText component
    11→- **Icon Integration**: SVG icon support with customizable attributes
    12→- **Dynamic Data Attributes**: Support for dynamic content and class management
    13→- **Interactions**: Support for dynamic content and class management
    14→- **Performance Optimized**: Efficient CSS generation and block rendering
    15→
    16→## 📋 Requirements
    17→
    18→- WordPress 5.0+ (Gutenberg support)
    19→- Greenlight Builder plugin or Greenshift plugin (parent plugin)
    20→- Bun (for development)
    21→- PHP 7.4+
    22→
    23→## 🛠️ Installation
    24→
    25→1. Clone this repository to your WordPress plugins directory:
    26→```bash
    27→git clone https://github.com/wpsoul/greenlightaddon.git
    28→cd greenlightaddon
    29→```
    30→
    31→2. Install dependencies:
    32→```bash
    33→bun install
    34→```
    35→
    36→3. Build the plugin:
    37→```bash
    38→bun run build
    39→```
    40→
    41→4. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel
    42→
    43→## 🏗️ Development
    44→
    45→### Available Scripts
    46→
    47→- `bun start` - Start development mode with hot reloading
    48→- `bun run build` - Build production assets
    49→- `bun run lint:js` - Lint JavaScript files
    50→- `bun run lint:style` - Lint CSS files
    51→
    52→### Project Structure
    53→
    54→```
    55→greenlightaddon/
    56→├── src/
    57→│   └── blocks/
    58→│       └── example/
    59→│           ├── edit.js          # Block editor component
    60→│           ├── inspector.js     # Block inspector controls
    61→│           ├── save.js          # Block save component
    62→│           └── index.js         # Block registration
    63→├── build/                       # Compiled assets
    64→├── greenlightaddon.php         # Main plugin file
    65→└── package.json                # Dependencies and scripts
    66→```
    67→
    68→## 🔧 Block Editor Component (edit.js) Explained
    69→
    70→The `edit.js` file is the core component that handles the block's appearance and functionality in the WordPress editor. Here's a detailed breakdown of its components:
    71→
    72→### Dependencies
    73→
    74→#### WordPress Dependencies
    75→- `wp.i18n` - Internationalization support
    76→- `wp.element` - React hooks (useRef, useEffect)
    77→- `wp.blockEditor` - Gutenberg block editor components (RichText, useBlockProps)
    78→
    79→#### Greenlight Dependencies
    80→- `gspblib.utilities` - Core utility functions for block management
    81→- `gspblib.helpers` - Helper functions for CSS generation
    82→- `gspblib.components` - Reusable UI components
    83→- `gspblib.collections` - Animation and wrapper components
    84→
    85→### Key Components Breakdown
    86→
    87→#### 1. Block ID Management
    88→```javascript
    89→useEffect(() => {
    90→    gspb_setBlockId(props, 2);
    91→}, []);
    92→```
    93→- Generates unique IDs for each block instance
    94→- Ensures proper block identification and styling
    95→
    96→#### 2. Local ID Management
    97→```javascript
    98→useEffect(() => {
    99→    if (id != null) {
   100→        // Logic for setting localId based on block ID. Used for root class. While id is unique, localId can be shared between several blocks
   101→        props.setAttributes({ localId: id });
   102→    }
   103→}, [id]);
   104→```
   105→- Manages CSS class names for styling
   106→- Allows similar styling across multiple blocks
   107→
   108→#### 3. Animation System
   109→```javascript
   110→const animationRef = useRef();
   111→let AnimationProps = AnimationRenderProps(animation, interactionLayers);
   112→```
   113→- Provides AOS (Animate On Scroll) animation support
   114→- It has stagger support, hover actions, svg animations, etc
   115→- Handles interaction layers for complex animations
   116→- Uses refs for animation targeting
   117→
   118→#### 4. Dynamic Data Attributes
   119→```javascript
   120→let DynamicDataAttributes = getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props);
   121→```
   122→- Supports dynamic content integration
   123→- Enables class panel functionality
   124→- Allows runtime attribute modification
   125→- In blockrender folder, find server side rendering for block with gl_dynamic_placeholders that handle dynamic placeholders for content
   126→
   127→#### 5. CSS Generation System
   128→
   129→##### Dynamic Local Classes
   130→```javascript
   131→final_css = getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, final_css);
   132→```
   133→- Generates CSS from dynamic class system
   134→
   135→##### Style Attributes
   136→```javascript
   137→if (styleAttributes) {
   138→    local_css = getCssFromStyleAttributes(styleAttributes, css_selector_by_user, local_css, enableSpecificity);
   139→}
   140→```
   141→- Converts style attributes to CSS
   142→- Supports specificity control for CSS priority
   143→
   144→##### Animation CSS
   145→```javascript
   146→final_css = aos_animation_cssGen(animation, css_selector_by_user, final_css, props);
   147→```
   148→- Generates AOS animation CSS
   149→- Handles keyframe animations and transitions
   150→
   151→##### Device-Responsive CSS
   152→```javascript
   153→final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   154→    css_selector_by_user,
   155→    ['font-size'],
   156→    [
   157→        [
   158→            [(unitArray && unitArray[0]) ? unitArray[0] : null],
   159→            [(unitArray && unitArray[1]) ? unitArray[1] : null],
   160→            [(unitArray && unitArray[2]) ? unitArray[2] : null],
   161→            [(unitArray && unitArray[3]) ? unitArray[3] : null],
   162→        ],
   163→    ], // [desktop, tablet, mobile, mobile-small]
   164→    final_css
   165→);
   166→```
   167→- gspb_cssGen is used to generate css for specific css option. First parameter - selector where to apply styles, second - array of css options, third - array of values for desktop, tablet, mobile, and mobile-small breakpoints. 
   168→##### Static CSS Properties
   169→```javascript
   170→final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   171→    css_selector_by_user,
   172→    ['color'],
   173→    [colorValue],
   174→    final_css
   175→);
   176→```
   177→- Handles non-responsive CSS properties
   178→- Supports any CSS property with single values
   179→
   180→#### 6. Block Props Configuration
   181→```javascript
   182→let blockProps = useBlockProps({
   183→    "data-gspb-block-id": props.attributes.id,
   184→    className: `gspb-selector-element ${localId ? localId : ''}`,
   185→    ref: animationRef,
   186→    ...DynamicDataAttributes,
   187→    ...AnimationProps
   188→});
   189→```
   190→- Combines all block attributes and properties + some extra attributes for editor.
   191→- Sets up proper CSS classes and data attributes
   192→- Integrates animation and dynamic data support
   193→
   194→#### 7. Editor-Specific Styling
   195→```javascript
   196→let editor_css = gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(final_css);
   197→```
   198→- Converts frontend CSS for editor compatibility
   199→- Ensures consistent styling between editor and frontend
   200→
   201→#### 8. Component Rendering
   202→
   203→##### Animation Wrapper
   204→```javascript
   205→<AnimationWrapper attributes={props.attributes} props={props} animationExtRef={animationRef}>
   206→```
   207→- Wraps the entire block for animation support
   208→- Provides animation context and lifecycle management
   209→
   210→##### Inspector and Toolbar
   211→```javascript
   212→{props.isSelected && (
   213→    <>
   214→        <Inspector {...props} />
   215→        <BlockToolBar {...props} />
   216→    </>
   217→)}
   218→```
   219→- Shows block controls only when block is selected
   220→- Provides customization interface for users
   221→
   222→##### Rich Text Component
   223→```javascript
   224→<RichText
   225→    tagName={'span'}
   226→    placeholder={__("Greenlight - Page-Building Gutenberg Blocks", 'greenlightaddon')}
   227→    value={textContent}
   228→    onChange={(value) => {
   229→        props.setAttributes({ textContent: value });
   230→    }}
   231→/>
   232→```
   233→- Provides rich text editing capabilities
   234→- Supports formatting, links, and other text features
   235→- Handles content updates and persistence
   236→
   237→
   238→##### Style Tabs
   239→```javascript
   240→<AttributeTabs
   241→    attributeName="styleAttributes"
   242→    {...props}
   243→    defaultTab={''}
   244→    includes={['typography', 'color', 'spacing', 'shadow', 'border', 'position', 'size', 'layout', 'effects', 'csstransform', 'responsive']} svgcolors={true} selfAlign={"both"}
   245→/>
   246→```
   247→- Provides rich style control
   248→- You can select which panels to include
   249→- If you don't want to have tabs, you can put only one option in includes parameter
   250→
   251→##### SVG Icon Viewer
   252→```javascript
   253→{iconBox && (
   254→    <SVGViewer attributeName="icon" blockProps={blockProps} {...props} />
   255→)}
   256→```
   257→- Renders SVG icons for Icon component
   258→- Integrates with the block's styling system
   259→
   260→##### Dynamic CSS Injection
   261→```javascript
   262→{editor_css && (
   263→    <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: editor_css }} />
   264→)}
   265→```
   266→- Injects generated CSS directly into the editor
   267→- Ensures real-time styling updates in editor
   268→
   269→## 🎨 Customization
   270→
   271→### Adding New CSS Properties
   272→
   273→To add support for new CSS properties, use the `gspb_cssGen` helper:
   274→
   275→```javascript
   276→// For responsive properties
   277→final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   278→    css_selector_by_user,
   279→    ['margin-top', 'padding-bottom'],
   280→    [responsiveValues],
   281→    final_css
   282→);
   283→
   284→// For static properties
   285→final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   286→    css_selector_by_user,
   287→    ['background-color'],
   288→    [backgroundColor],
   289→    final_css
   290→);
   291→```
   292→
   293→### Adding New Attributes
   294→
   295→1. Add the attribute to your block's `attributes` object in `index.js`
   296→2. Destructure it in the `edit.js` component
   297→3. Use it in your CSS generation or component logic
   298→4. Add corresponding controls in `inspector.js`
   299→
   300→## 📚 API Reference
   301→
   302→### Greenlight Library Functions
   303→
   304→- `gspb_setBlockId(props, prefix)` - Sets unique block ID
   305→- `getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props)` - Gets dynamic data attributes
   306→- `getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, css)` - Generates CSS from dynamic classes
   307→- `getCssFromStyleAttributes(attributes, selector, css, specificity)` - Converts style attributes to CSS
   308→- `aos_animation_cssGen(animation, selector, css, props)` - Generates animation CSS
   309→- `gspb_cssGen(selector, properties, values, css)` - Generates custom CSS
   310→- `gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(css)` - Converts CSS for editor compatibility
   311→- `gspb_Css_Final(id, css, props)` - Stores final CSS
   312→
   313→### Components
   314→
   315→- `AnimationWrapper` - Wraps blocks with animation support
   316→- `BlockToolBar` - Provides block toolbar controls
   317→- `SVGViewer` - Renders SVG icons
   318→- `BlpgeColorPicker` - Special Color component, use instead of core color component of gutenberg for extra features (more presets, color picker, variables)
   319→- `UnitControl` - Improved UnitControl, use instead of core UnitControl for extra features (right mouse click for variable selection)
   320→- `Devices` - Device Selector
   321→
   322→## 🤝 Contributing
   323→
   324→1. Fork the repository
   325→2. Create a feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`)
   326→3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'Add some amazing feature'`)
   327→4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`)
   328→5. Open a Pull Request

     2→
     3→I'm building a custom WordPress block library for my agency that brings Shadcn's design system to the Greenshift/GreenLight ecosystem. We want to use Shadcn's design tokens and component styles without Tailwind compilation—instead leveraging GreenLight's class registration system. This repo is forked and cloned copy of the Greenligh Addon Scaffold mentioned below. The goal is to read these instructions, decide which subagents should be created to effectively analyze the referenced repos and documentation, create the subagents to do so, and create a project plan with Claude.md file and instructions to track the list of todo's and project progress during each session.

    45→### Shadcn Button Component Reference
    46→
    47→The Shadcn button has these configurable options:

    49→**Variants (6):**
    50→- `default` - Primary background, primary-foreground text
    51→- `destructive` - Destructive background, destructive-foreground text

    53→- `secondary` - Secondary background, secondary-foreground text

    55→- `link` - Text only with underline on hover
    56→
    57→**Sizes (4):**

    60→- `lg` - h-10 px-6
    61→- `icon` - h-9 w-9 (square)
    62→
    63→**Additional props to support:**

# CSS Variables Registration with Greenshift

Based on the provided documentation, the page does **not contain information about registering CSS variables or custom properties** with Greenshift. 

The content focuses exclusively on:

1. **Preset Classes** - Ready-made styles attached to classes (e.g., `'css'=> ".gs_border_elegant{border:1px solid #00000012}"`)

2. **Framework Classes** - Classes without attached styles that load independently from themes/plugins

3. **Class Groups** - Using filters like `greenshift_style_preset_classes`, `greenshift_interaction_preset_classes`, etc.

4. **Core Framework Integration** - Enabling utility classes from the Core Framework Gutenberg plugin

## What's Actually Documented

The tutorial explains how to inject classes through filters such as:
- `greenshift_preset_classes` (custom groups)
- `greenshift_framework_classes` (framework-specific groups)

However, there is **no section addressing**:
- Custom CSS variable registration
- The `greenshift_global_variables` filter
- Making variables appear in color pickers
- Specific variable format requirements

To obtain this information, you would need to consult additional Greenshift documentation or contact their support directly, as it's not covered in this particular guide.
```

Based on my research, here is a comprehensive summary of the code examples and documentation for registering CSS custom properties/variables in Greenshift:

---

## Greenshift Global Variables Registration

### The `greenshift_global_variables` Filter

This is the primary filter for registering CSS variables that appear in Greenshift's color picker and variable selectors.

**Array Structure:**

```php
array(
    'label'          => 'Display Name',           // UI label shown in picker
    'value'          => 'var(--variable-name)',   // CSS variable reference
    'variable'       => '--variable-name',        // Variable identifier (with dashes)
    'variable_value' => '#ff5500',                // Actual CSS value
    'group'          => 'color'                   // Category: 'color', 'size', or 'spacing'
)
```

**Complete Example:**

```php
add_filter('greenshift_global_variables', 'my_custom_variable_for_gs');
function my_custom_variable_for_gs($variables){
    if(empty($variables)){
        $variables = array();
    }
    $variables[] = array(
       'label'=> 'XS Size',
       'value'=> "var(--gs--size-xs)",
       'variable' => "--gs--size-xs",
       'variable_value' => "0.85rem",
       'group' => 'size'
    );
    return $variables;
}
```

### Predefined Groups
- **color** - For color variables (appears in color pickers)
- **size** - For size/dimension variables
- **spacing** - For margin/padding variables

---

## Preset Classes Registration

### Available Filter Hooks

Greenshift provides seven filters to inject classes into existing preset groups:

1. `greenshift_style_preset_classes`
2. `greenshift_interaction_preset_classes`
3. `greenshift_spacing_preset_classes`
4. `greenshift_shadow_preset_classes`
5. `greenshift_border_preset_classes`
6. `greenshift_background_preset_classes`
7. `greenshift_data_preset_classes`

### Preset Class Structure

```php
array(
    'value' => 'class-name',           // CSS class name (no dot)
    'label' => 'Display Name',         // UI label
    'type'  => 'preset',               // 'preset' includes CSS, 'framework' does not
    'css'   => '.class-name{styles}'   // CSS rules (only for 'preset' type)
)
```

### Adding to Existing Groups

```php
add_filter('greenshift_style_preset_classes', 'mycustom_greenshift_style_classes');
function mycustom_greenshift_style_classes($options){
   $options[] = [
      'value'=> 'mb10',
      'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
      'type' => "preset",
      'css' => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"
   ];
   return $options;
}
```

### Creating Custom Preset Groups

```php
add_filter('greenshift_preset_classes', 'mycustom_greenshift_preset_classes_group');
function mycustom_greenshift_preset_classes_group($options){
   return array(
      array(
         'label' => esc_html__('My New group Presets', 'textdomain'),
         'options' => array(
            array(
               'value'=> 'mb10',
               'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
               'type' => "preset",
               'css' => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"
            ),
            array(
               'value'=> 'mb20',
               'label'=> "Margin Bottom 20px",
               'type' => "preset",
               'css' => ".mb20{margin-bottom:20px}"
            )
         )
      )
   );
}
```

### Creating Custom Framework Groups

For external CSS frameworks (CSS not embedded):

```php
add_filter('greenshift_framework_classes', 'mycustom_greenshift_framework_classes_group');
function mycustom_greenshift_framework_classes_group($options){
   return array(
      array(
         'label' => esc_html__('My New group framework', 'textdomain'),
         'options' => array(
            array(
               'value'=> 'mb10',
               'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
               'type' => "framework",  // No 'css' key needed
            )
         )
      )
   );
}
```

Based on the search results, here's how to register color variables in Greenshift WordPress plugin custom CSS properties:

## Registering Color Variables Programmatically

Greenshift has a variable system which you can select in each option. You can use the Core Framework free plugin to extend them and enable Core framework integration in Greenshift settings – Interface.

To register your own color variables programmatically, use this code:

```php
add_filter('greenshift_global_variables', 'my_custom_variable_for_gs');
function my_custom_variable_for_gs($variables){
    if(empty($variables)){
        $variables = array();
    }
    $variables[] = array(
        'label'=> 'My Custom Color',
        'value'=> "var(--my-custom-color)",
        'variable' => "--my-custom-color",
        'variable_value' => "#ff5500",
        'group' => 'color'
    );
    return $variables;
}
```

This will register a variable with a label and key, along with its value. There are several predefined groups: size, spacing, color.

## Using Variables in the Interface

Global variables can be set via Stylebook and dynamically set by Interaction layers. There are many variables already integrated in presets of Greenshift. Not all fields support variables, but all fields with unit controls do.(no content)To add or select a variable, you can type "var" in a field OR click on the arrow near the left bottom corner OR make a right mouse click on the field.

## Theme Color Inheritance

Greenshift plugin has color inheritance from themes if the theme uses theme.json file to register color and gradient palettes or via add_theme_support. Colors from the Theme palette will be available in all plugin's color-related components.

## Stylebook Method

You can manually enter CSS variables or import them in bulk. The input area to import them is at the bottom of the screen.

Based on my search, here's information about adding custom colors to the Greenshift GreenLight color picker in WordPress:

## Adding Custom Colors to Greenshift/GreenLight

### Using the Stylebook
In the Color options of the Stylebook, you can set your own set of custom colors and gradients.(no content)You need to click on the Save button to save element options. Without saving, you can experiment with settings, but they will be lost after page reload.

### Theme Integration
Greenshift plugin has color inheritance from themes if the theme uses a theme.json file to register color and gradient palettes or via add_theme_support. Colors from the Theme palette will be available in all plugin's color-related components.

### Greenlight Elements Approach
On the Elements tab you can set the typography and color settings for headings, body, and button.(no content)By clicking a small contextual icon on the input box, a popup shows with the CSS variables imported via the Stylebook. By clicking on one then it is pasted into the settings input.

### Figma Integration
Greenshift has a special free plugin for Figma which allows you to make a Stylebook in Figma with one click and then connect and synchronize it with the Greenshift site.

### Using the Style Editor (for Greenshift Theme)
The main part where you need to change your global styles is the Style editor. The theme has many predefined colors and you can hover over each color to see where it's used.(no content)There are two critical colors – Base and Contrast color which are responsible for the content background and content text. If you change these colors, the background under your content will be also changed so it's not recommended to change it too much. Both colors must be opposite to make them contrast.

For more detailed configuration, you may want to check the official Greenshift documentation at greenshiftwp.com/documentation/greenshift-basics/stylebook-and-global-elements/.

# Greenshift Custom Variables Registration

## PHP Code Example

The documentation provides one complete example using the `greenshift_global_variables` filter:

```php
add_filter('greenshift_global_variables', 'my_custom_variable_for_gs');
function my_custom_variable_for_gs($variables){
    if(empty($variables)){
        $variables = array();
    }
    $variables[] = array(
       'label'=> 'XS Size',
       'value'=> "var(--gs--size-xs)",
       'variable' => "--gs--size-xs",
       'variable_value' => "0.85rem",
       'group' => 'size'
    );
    return $variables;
}
```

## Array Structure Fields

Each variable registration requires these properties:

| Field | Example | Purpose |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `label` | 'XS Size' | Display name in the UI |
| `value` | "var(--gs--size-xs)" | CSS variable reference |
| `variable` | "--gs--size-xs" | Variable identifier |
| `variable_value` | "0.85rem" | Actual CSS value |
| `group` | 'size' | Categorization |

## Predefined Groups

The system includes three built-in groups: **size**, **spacing**, and **color**. Developers can also create custom group categories beyond these defaults.

# Greenshift CSS Framework Registration Guide

## Filter Hooks for Preset Classes

Greenshift provides seven filters to inject classes into existing preset groups:

1. `greenshift_style_preset_classes`
2. `greenshift_interaction_preset_classes`
3. `greenshift_spacing_preset_classes`
4. `greenshift_shadow_preset_classes`
5. `greenshift_border_preset_classes`
6. `greenshift_background_preset_classes`
7. `greenshift_data_preset_classes`

## Preset Class Structure

A preset class requires this array format:

```php
[
   'value'=> 'gs_border_elegant',
   'label'=> "Border Elegant",
   'css'=> ".gs_border_elegant{border:1px solid #00000012}",
   'type' => "preset"
]
```

## Framework Class Structure

Framework classes omit inline CSS:

```php
[
   'value'=> 'mb10',
   'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
   'type' => "framework"
]
```

## Adding to Existing Preset Groups

```php
add_filter('greenshift_style_preset_classes', 'mycustom_greenshift_style_classes');
function mycustom_greenshift_style_classes($options){
   $options[] = [
      'value'=> 'mb10',
      'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
      'type' => "preset",
      'css' => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"
   ];
   return $options;
}
```

## Creating Custom Preset Groups

```php
add_filter('greenshift_preset_classes', 'mycustom_greenshift_preset_classes_group');
function mycustom_greenshift_preset_classes_group($options){
   return array(
      array(
         'label' => esc_html__('My New group Presets', 'textdomain'),
         'options' => array(
            array(
               'value'=> 'mb10',
               'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
               'type' => "preset",
               'css' => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"
            ),
            array(
               'value'=> 'mb20',
               'label'=> "Margin Bottom 20px",
               'type' => "preset",
               'css' => ".mb20{margin-bottom:20px}"
            )
         )
      )
   );
}
```

## Creating Custom Framework Groups

```php
add_filter('greenshift_framework_classes', 'mycustom_greenshift_framework_classes_group');
function mycustom_greenshift_framework_classes_group($options){
   return array(
      array(
         'label' => esc_html__('My New group framework', 'textdomain'),
         'options' => array(
            array(
               'value'=> 'mb10',
               'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
               'type' => "framework",
            ),
            array(
               'value'=> 'mb20',
               'label'=> "Margin Bottom 20px",
               'type' => "framework",
            )
         )
      )
   );
}
```

## Core Framework Integration

Enable the Core Framework option in Greenshift's Interface settings to inject Core Framework utility classes. Ensure Core Framework's font size is set to 100% for proper alignment.

# Greenshift Programmatic Block Addition

Based on the provided content, there are **no PHP or JavaScript code examples** showing how to add blocks programmatically in Greenshift.

## What the Article Actually Covers

The tutorial discusses two methods for adding styles to programmatically-created blocks:

**Method 1: Inline CSS Styles**
The article shows a block comment structure with an `inlineCssStyles` attribute containing CSS rules. The example demonstrates: `"inlineCssStyles":".gsbp-2f32680{background-color:#c44242;color:#ffffff;}"`

**Method 2: Server-Side Rendering**
Uses a `CSSRender` attribute set to `1` on blocks, allowing the server to render styles from `styleAttributes` without embedding CSS directly.

## Key Implementation Details

- Style attributes use camelCase syntax (e.g., `backgroundColor` instead of `background-color`)
- Style values must be arrays supporting up to four device breakpoints: desktop, tablet, mobile landscape, mobile portrait
- Use `null` to skip specific breakpoints
- Alternative HTML-to-blocks conversion requires generating unique block IDs and mapping styles accordingly

The article references an `instruction_markdown.md` file in the plugin root for detailed technical specifications, but this documentation isn't included in the provided content.

Based on my research, here is a comprehensive summary of the code examples and documentation for registering CSS custom properties/variables in Greenshift:

---

## Greenshift Global Variables Registration

### The `greenshift_global_variables` Filter

This is the primary filter for registering CSS variables that appear in Greenshift's color picker and variable selectors.

**Array Structure:**

```php
array(
    'label'          => 'Display Name',           // UI label shown in picker
    'value'          => 'var(--variable-name)',   // CSS variable reference
    'variable'       => '--variable-name',        // Variable identifier (with dashes)
    'variable_value' => '#ff5500',                // Actual CSS value
    'group'          => 'color'                   // Category: 'color', 'size', or 'spacing'
)
```

**Complete Example:**

```php
add_filter('greenshift_global_variables', 'my_custom_variable_for_gs');
function my_custom_variable_for_gs($variables){
    if(empty($variables)){
        $variables = array();
    }
    $variables[] = array(
       'label'=> 'XS Size',
       'value'=> "var(--gs--size-xs)",
       'variable' => "--gs--size-xs",
       'variable_value' => "0.85rem",
       'group' => 'size'
    );
    return $variables;
}
```

### Predefined Groups
- **color** - For color variables (appears in color pickers)
- **size** - For size/dimension variables
- **spacing** - For margin/padding variables

---

## Preset Classes Registration

### Available Filter Hooks

Greenshift provides seven filters to inject classes into existing preset groups:

1. `greenshift_style_preset_classes`
2. `greenshift_interaction_preset_classes`
3. `greenshift_spacing_preset_classes`
4. `greenshift_shadow_preset_classes`
5. `greenshift_border_preset_classes`
6. `greenshift_background_preset_classes`
7. `greenshift_data_preset_classes`

### Preset Class Structure

```php
array(
    'value' => 'class-name',           // CSS class name (no dot)
    'label' => 'Display Name',         // UI label
    'type'  => 'preset',               // 'preset' includes CSS, 'framework' does not
    'css'   => '.class-name{styles}'   // CSS rules (only for 'preset' type)
)
```

### Adding to Existing Groups

```php
add_filter('greenshift_style_preset_classes', 'mycustom_greenshift_style_classes');
function mycustom_greenshift_style_classes($options){
   $options[] = [
      'value'=> 'mb10',
      'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
      'type' => "preset",
      'css' => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"
   ];
   return $options;
}
```

### Creating Custom Preset Groups

```php
add_filter('greenshift_preset_classes', 'mycustom_greenshift_preset_classes_group');
function mycustom_greenshift_preset_classes_group($options){
   return array(
      array(
         'label' => esc_html__('My New group Presets', 'textdomain'),
         'options' => array(
            array(
               'value'=> 'mb10',
               'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
               'type' => "preset",
               'css' => ".mb10{margin-bottom:10px}"
            ),
            array(
               'value'=> 'mb20',
               'label'=> "Margin Bottom 20px",
               'type' => "preset",
               'css' => ".mb20{margin-bottom:20px}"
            )
         )
      )
   );
}
```

### Creating Custom Framework Groups

For external CSS frameworks (CSS not embedded):

```php
add_filter('greenshift_framework_classes', 'mycustom_greenshift_framework_classes_group');
function mycustom_greenshift_framework_classes_group($options){
   return array(
      array(
         'label' => esc_html__('My New group framework', 'textdomain'),
         'options' => array(
            array(
               'value'=> 'mb10',
               'label'=> "Margin Bottom 10px",
               'type' => "framework",  // No 'css' key needed
            )
         )
      )
   );
}
```

---

# Greenshift Global Variables Filter Documentation

## 1. Filter Syntax and Format

The `greenshift_global_variables` filter allows programmatic registration of custom variables. The basic structure:

```php
add_filter('greenshift_global_variables', 'my_custom_variable_for_gs');
function my_custom_variable_for_gs($variables){
    if(empty($variables)){
        $variables = array();
    }
    $variables[] = array(
       'label'=> 'Variable Label',
       'value'=> "var(--css-var-name)",
       'variable' => "--css-var-name",
       'variable_value' => "actual-value",
       'group' => 'group-name'
    );
    return $variables;
}
```

**Array Parameters:**
- `label`: Display name in the UI
- `value`: CSS variable reference
- `variable`: CSS custom property name
- `variable_value`: Actual CSS value
- `group`: Categorization group

## 2. Color Variable Registration

The documentation mentions "several predefined groups: size, spacing, color" but doesn't provide a specific color-only example. To register a color variable, use the same structure with `'group' => 'color'`:

```php
$variables[] = array(
   'label'=> 'Primary Color',
   'value'=> "var(--gs--color-primary)",
   'variable' => "--gs--color-primary",
   'variable_value' => "#7000f4",
   'group' => 'color'
);
```

## 3. Hook Timing Requirements

The documentation states you can "register variable...programmatically" but specifies no particular timing constraints. Standard WordPress filter conventions apply—execution occurs when the filter is called during variable initialization.

## 4. Alternative Methods

The guide references the "Core Framework free plugin" as an alternative to programmatic registration, suggesting you can enable integration through Greenshift settings rather than code.
```

### Available Developer Filters
Greenshift does provide several developer filter hooks, but for **preset classes**, not specifically for colors:

    53→				} else {
    54→					props.setAttributes({ localId: id });
    55→				}
    56→			}
    57→		}
    58→	}, [id]);
    59→
    60→	// Render Icon Box
    61→	let iconBox = icon ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(icon)) : null;
    62→
    63→	//Render Animation Properties for Animation Panel support
    64→	const animationRef = useRef();
    65→	let AnimationProps = {};
    66→	AnimationProps = AnimationRenderProps(animation, interactionLayers);
    67→
    68→	// Get Dynamic Data Attributes for Dynamic Data Panel support (Class panel)
    69→	let DynamicDataAttributes = getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props);
    70→
    71→	// Set Block Props for the block
    72→	let blockProps = useBlockProps({
    73→		"data-gspb-block-id": props.attributes.id,
    74→		className: `gspb-selector-element ${localId ? localId : ''}`,
    75→		ref: animationRef,
    76→		...DynamicDataAttributes,
    77→		...AnimationProps
    78→	});
    79→
    80→	let css_selector_by_user = '.' + localId;
    81→	let final_css = '';
    82→	// Get Final CSS from Dynamic Local Classes
    83→	final_css = getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, final_css);
    84→
    85→	let local_css = '';
    86→	// Get CSS from Style Attributes
    87→	if (styleAttributes) {
    88→		local_css = getCssFromStyleAttributes(styleAttributes, css_selector_by_user, local_css, enableSpecificity);
    89→	}
    90→	if (local_css != '') {
    91→		final_css += local_css;
    92→	}
    93→
    94→	// Animation CSS Generation
    95→	final_css = aos_animation_cssGen(
    96→		animation,
    97→		css_selector_by_user,
    98→		final_css,
    99→		props
   100→	);
   101→
   102→	// Example for Device Related custom CSS Generation
   103→	final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   104→		css_selector_by_user,
   105→		['font-size'],
   106→		[
   107→			[
   108→				[(unitArray && unitArray[0]) ? unitArray[0] : null],
   109→				[(unitArray && unitArray[1]) ? unitArray[1] : null],
   110→				[(unitArray && unitArray[2]) ? unitArray[2] : null],
   111→				[(unitArray && unitArray[3]) ? unitArray[3] : null],
   112→			],
   113→		],
   114→		final_css
   115→	);
   116→
   117→	// Example for non Device Related custom CSS Generation
   118→	final_css = gspb_cssGen(
   119→		css_selector_by_user,
   120→		['color'],
   121→		[color],
   122→		final_css
   123→	);
   124→
   125→	let ElementTag = 'div';
   126→
   127→	if (anchor) {
   128→		blockProps.id = anchor;
   129→	}
   130→
   131→	// Get Final CSS for Editor. Attach editor-styles-wrapper to the block in editor.
   132→	let editor_css = final_css;
   133→	editor_css = gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(editor_css);
   134→
   135→	// Set Stored CSS
   136→	gspb_Css_Final(id, final_css, props);
   137→
   138→	return (
   139→		<>
   140→			<AnimationWrapper attributes={props.attributes} props={props} animationExtRef={animationRef}>
   141→				{props.isSelected &&
   142→					<>
   143→						<Inspector {...props} />
   144→						<BlockToolBar {...props} />
   145→					</>
   146→				}
   147→				<ElementTag {...blockProps}>
   148→					<RichText
   149→						tagName={'span'}
   150→						placeholder={__("Enter text...", 'altitude-blocks')}
   151→						value={textContent}
   152→						onChange={(value) => {
   153→							props.setAttributes({ textContent: value });
   154→						}}
   155→					/>
   156→					{iconBox &&
   157→						<SVGViewer attributeName="icon" blockProps={blockProps} {...props} />
   158→					}
   159→					{editor_css && (
   160→						<style
   161→							dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
   162→								__html: editor_css,
   163→							}}
   164→						/>
   165→					)}
   166→				</ElementTag>
   167→			</AnimationWrapper>
   168→		</>
   169→	);
   170→
   171→}
```
</details></tool-use>

     4→namespace greenlightaddon\Blocks;
     5→defined('ABSPATH') OR exit;
     6→
     7→
     8→class Renderbox{
     9→
    10→	public function __construct(){
    11→		add_action('init', array( $this, 'init_handler' ));
    12→	}
    13→
    14→	public function init_handler(){
    15→		register_block_type(__DIR__, array(
    16→			'render_callback' => array( $this, 'render_block' ),
    17→		)
    18→		);
    19→	}
    20→
    21→	public function render_block($settings, $inner_content, $block)
    22→	{
    23→		$block = (is_array($block)) ? $block : $block->parsed_block;
    24→		$html = $inner_content;
    25→
    26→		// Support for Hide on Frontend option
    27→		if(!empty($block['attrs']['styleAttributes']['hideOnFrontend_Extra'])){
    28→			if(!is_admin()){
    29→				return '';
    30→			}
    31→		}
    32→
    33→		//Polyfills
    34→		if(!empty($block['attrs']['styleAttributes']['animationTimeline'])){
    35→			wp_enqueue_script('scroll-view-polyfill');
    36→		}
    37→		if(!empty($block['attrs']['styleAttributes']['anchorName'])){
    38→			wp_enqueue_script('anchor-polyfill');
    39→		}
    40→
    41→		if(!empty($block['attrs']['textContent'])){
    42→			if(strpos($block['attrs']['textContent'], '{{') !== false){
    43→				//Apply dynamic placeholders to text content
    44→				$html = gl_dynamic_placeholders($html);
    45→			}
    46→		}
    47→
    48→		return $html;
    49→	}
    50→}
    51→
    52→new Renderbox;

 * Shadcn Button Block
 *
 * A button component following Shadcn's design system with
 * 6 variants and 4 sizes.
 */
import { __ } from '@wordpress/i18n';
import edit from './edit';
import save from './save';
import { registerBlockType } from '@wordpress/blocks';
import blockIcon from './icon';
import attributes from './attributes';

registerBlockType('altitude-blocks/button', {
	category: 'altitude-blocks',
	icon: blockIcon,
	example: {
		attributes: {
			text: 'Click me',
			variant: 'default',
			size: 'default',
		},
	},
	title: __('Shadcn Button', 'altitude-blocks'),
	description: __('A button component with multiple variants and sizes following Shadcn design system.', 'altitude-blocks'),
	keywords: [
		__('button', 'altitude-blocks'),
		__('shadcn', 'altitude-blocks'),
		__('link', 'altitude-blocks'),
		__('cta', 'altitude-blocks'),
	],
	attributes,
	edit,
	save,
});

/**
 * Shadcn Button Block - Edit Component
 */

// WordPress dependencies
const { __ } = wp.i18n;
const { useRef, useEffect } = wp.element;
const { RichText, useBlockProps } = wp.blockEditor;

// Greenlight dependencies
const { gspb_setBlockId, getDataAttributesfromDynamic } = gspblib.utilities;
const {
	aos_animation_cssGen,
	gspb_Css_Final,
	getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses,
	getCssFromStyleAttributes,
} = gspblib.utilities;
const { gspb_cssGen, gspb_convert_styles_for_editor } = gspblib.helpers;
const { BlockToolBar, SVGViewer } = gspblib.components;
const { AnimationRenderProps, AnimationWrapper } = gspblib.collections;

// Inspector
import Inspector from './inspector';

// Button variant and size class mappings
const VARIANT_CLASSES = {
	default: 'shadcn-btn-default',
	destructive: 'shadcn-btn-destructive',
	outline: 'shadcn-btn-outline',
	secondary: 'shadcn-btn-secondary',
	ghost: 'shadcn-btn-ghost',
	link: 'shadcn-btn-link',
};

const SIZE_CLASSES = {
	default: 'shadcn-btn-size-default',
	sm: 'shadcn-btn-sm',
	lg: 'shadcn-btn-lg',
	icon: 'shadcn-btn-icon',
};

export default function edit(props) {
	const {
		id,
		localId,
		animation,
		styleAttributes,
		enableSpecificity,
		interactionLayers,
		anchor,
		// Button specific
		text,
		variant,
		size,
		href,
		disabled,
		fullWidth,
		icon,
		iconPosition,
	} = props.attributes;

	// Generate Unique ID for The Block
	useEffect(() => {
		gspb_setBlockId(props, 2);
	}, []);

	// Set Root class for the block
	useEffect(() => {
		if (id != null) {
			if (props.attributes.localId && props.attributes.localId == id) {
				// do nothing
			} else {
				if (props.attributes.staticLocalId && props.attributes.localId) {
					// do nothing
				} else {
					props.setAttributes({ localId: id });
				}
			}
		}
	}, [id]);

	// Render Icon Box
	let iconBox = icon ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(icon)) : null;

	// Render Animation Properties
	const animationRef = useRef();
	let AnimationProps = AnimationRenderProps(animation, interactionLayers);

	// Get Dynamic Data Attributes
	let DynamicDataAttributes = getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props);

	// Build button classes
	const buttonClasses = [
		'shadcn-btn',
		VARIANT_CLASSES[variant] || VARIANT_CLASSES.default,
		SIZE_CLASSES[size] || SIZE_CLASSES.default,
		fullWidth ? 'shadcn-btn-full' : '',
		localId || '',
	].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

	// Set Block Props
	let blockProps = useBlockProps({
		'data-gspb-block-id': props.attributes.id,
		className: `gspb-selector-element ${buttonClasses}`,
		ref: animationRef,
		...DynamicDataAttributes,
		...AnimationProps,
	});

	// CSS Generation
	let css_selector_by_user = '.' + localId;
	let final_css = '';

	// Get Final CSS from Dynamic Local Classes
	final_css = getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, final_css);

	// Get CSS from Style Attributes
	let local_css = '';
	if (styleAttributes) {
		local_css = getCssFromStyleAttributes(styleAttributes, css_selector_by_user, local_css, enableSpecificity);
	}
	if (local_css != '') {
		final_css += local_css;
	}

	// Animation CSS Generation
	final_css = aos_animation_cssGen(animation, css_selector_by_user, final_css, props);

	// Determine element tag - use span in editor for proper block behavior
	let ElementTag = 'span';

	if (anchor) {
		blockProps.id = anchor;
	}

	if (disabled) {
		blockProps['aria-disabled'] = 'true';
		blockProps.className += ' shadcn-btn-disabled';
	}

	// Get Final CSS for Editor
	let editor_css = final_css;
	editor_css = gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(editor_css);

	// Set Stored CSS
	gspb_Css_Final(id, final_css, props);

	return (
		<>
			<AnimationWrapper attributes={props.attributes} props={props} animationExtRef={animationRef}>
				{props.isSelected && (
					<>
						<Inspector {...props} />
						<BlockToolBar {...props} />
					</>
				)}
				<ElementTag {...blockProps}>
					{iconBox && iconPosition === 'left' && (
						<SVGViewer attributeName="icon" blockProps={blockProps} {...props} />
					)}
					<RichText
						tagName="span"
						placeholder={__('Button text...', 'altitude-blocks')}
						value={text}
						onChange={(value) => {
							props.setAttributes({ text: value });
						}}
						allowedFormats={['core/bold', 'core/italic']}
					/>
					{iconBox && iconPosition === 'right' && (
						<SVGViewer attributeName="icon" blockProps={blockProps} {...props} />
					)}
					{editor_css && (
						<style
							dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
								__html: editor_css,
							}}
						/>
					)}
				</ElementTag>
			</AnimationWrapper>
		</>
	);
}

```

```

/**
 * Shadcn Button Block - Inspector Controls
 */

// WordPress dependencies
const { __ } = wp.i18n;
const { InspectorControls } = wp.blockEditor;
const { PanelBody, SelectControl, TextControl, ToggleControl, TextareaControl } = wp.components;
const { useState } = wp.element;
import isEqual from 'lodash/isEqual';
import attributesDefault from './attributes';

// Greenlight dependencies
const {
	Animation,
	InteractionsPanel,
	IconPicker,
	AttributeTabs,
} = gspblib.collections;
const { GlobalClasses } = gspblib.components;
const { collectionsObjects } = gspblib.helpers;

// Variant options
const VARIANT_OPTIONS = [
	{ label: __('Default', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'default' },
	{ label: __('Destructive', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'destructive' },
	{ label: __('Outline', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'outline' },
	{ label: __('Secondary', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'secondary' },
	{ label: __('Ghost', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'ghost' },
	{ label: __('Link', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'link' },
];

// Size options
const SIZE_OPTIONS = [
	{ label: __('Default', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'default' },
	{ label: __('Small', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'sm' },
	{ label: __('Large', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'lg' },
	{ label: __('Icon', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'icon' },
];

// Icon position options
const ICON_POSITION_OPTIONS = [
	{ label: __('Left', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'left' },
	{ label: __('Right', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'right' },
];

const Inspector = (props) => {
	const {
		attributes: {
			anchor,
			styleAttributes,
			enableSpecificity,
			staticLocalId,
			// Button specific
			text,
			variant,
			size,
			href,
			target,
			rel,
			disabled,
			fullWidth,
			icon,
			iconPosition,
		},
		setAttributes,
	} = props;

	const iconBox = icon ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(icon)) : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(collectionsObjects.iconPicker));

	let animationchange = isEqual(attributesDefault.animation.default, props.attributes.animation) ? false : true;
	let interactionchange = (typeof props.attributes.interactionLayers != 'undefined' && props.attributes.interactionLayers.length > 0) ? true : false;

	return (
		<>
			<InspectorControls>
				<div className="gspb_inspector gst-elements-inspector glfw-inspector">
					<GlobalClasses flexChild={true} {...props} />

					{/* Button Settings Panel */}
					<PanelBody title={__('Button Settings', 'altitude-blocks')} initialOpen={true}>
						<SelectControl
							label={__('Variant', 'altitude-blocks')}
							value={variant}
							options={VARIANT_OPTIONS}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ variant: value })}
							help={__('Choose the button style variant.', 'altitude-blocks')}
						/>
						<SelectControl
							label={__('Size', 'altitude-blocks')}
							value={size}
							options={SIZE_OPTIONS}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ size: value })}
						/>
						<ToggleControl
							label={__('Full Width', 'altitude-blocks')}
							checked={fullWidth}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ fullWidth: value })}
						/>
						<ToggleControl
							label={__('Disabled', 'altitude-blocks')}
							checked={disabled}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ disabled: value })}
						/>
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Link Settings Panel */}
					<PanelBody title={__('Link Settings', 'altitude-blocks')} initialOpen={false}>
						<TextControl
							label={__('URL', 'altitude-blocks')}
							value={href}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ href: value })}
							placeholder="https://"
						/>
						<ToggleControl
							label={__('Open in new tab', 'altitude-blocks')}
							checked={target === '_blank'}
							onChange={(value) => {
								setAttributes({
									target: value ? '_blank' : '_self',
									rel: value ? 'noopener noreferrer' : '',
								});
							}}
						/>
						{target === '_blank' && (
							<TextControl
								label={__('Rel attribute', 'altitude-blocks')}
								value={rel}
								onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ rel: value })}
								help={__('Default: noopener noreferrer', 'altitude-blocks')}
							/>
						)}
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Icon Settings Panel */}
					<PanelBody title={__('Icon', 'altitude-blocks')} initialOpen={false}>
						<IconPicker
							icon={iconBox}
							options={false}
							{...props}
							onChange={(icon) => {
								setAttributes({ icon: icon });
							}}
						/>
						{icon && (
							<SelectControl
								label={__('Icon Position', 'altitude-blocks')}
								value={iconPosition}
								options={ICON_POSITION_OPTIONS}
								onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ iconPosition: value })}
							/>
						)}
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Local Styles Panel */}
					<PanelBody
						title={__('Local Styles', 'altitude-blocks')}
						initialOpen={false}
						className="gst-inspector-tab gst-elements-styles"
					>
						<AttributeTabs
							attributeName="styleAttributes"
							{...props}
							defaultTab=""
							includes={['color', 'spacing', 'border', 'shadow', 'effects', 'responsive']}
							svgcolors={true}
							selfAlign="both"
						/>
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Animation Panel */}
					<PanelBody
						title={__('Animation', 'altitude-blocks')}
						initialOpen={false}
						className={`${!animationchange ? '' : 'gspb_panel_changed'}`}
					>
						<Animation attributeName="animation" {...props} />
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Interaction Layers Panel */}
					<PanelBody
						title={__('Interaction Layers', 'altitude-blocks')}
						initialOpen={false}
						className={`${interactionchange ? 'gspb_panel_changed' : ''}`}
					>
						<InteractionsPanel {...props} />
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Anchor & Root Class Panel */}
					<PanelBody
						title={__('Anchor & Root Class', 'altitude-blocks')}
						initialOpen={false}
						className={`${anchor || staticLocalId ? 'gspb_panel_changed' : ''}`}
					>
						<TextareaControl
							label={__('Anchor', 'altitude-blocks')}
							help={__('Set an anchor (ID) for this element.', 'altitude-blocks')}
							value={anchor}
							onChange={(value) => {
								let newvalue = value.trim();
								setAttributes({ anchor: newvalue });
							}}
						/>
					</PanelBody>
				</div>
			</InspectorControls>
		</>
	);
};

export default Inspector;

```

// WordPress dependencies
const { __ } = wp.i18n;
const { RichText } = wp.blockEditor;
import isEqual from 'lodash/isEqual';

// Import block dependencies
import attributes from './attributes';

// Greenlight dependencies
const { getDataAttributesfromDynamic } = gspblib.utilities;
const { AnimationRenderProps } = gspblib.collections;
const { SVGViewer } = gspblib.components;

// Button variant and size class mappings
const VARIANT_CLASSES = {
	default: 'shadcn-btn-default',
	destructive: 'shadcn-btn-destructive',
	outline: 'shadcn-btn-outline',
	secondary: 'shadcn-btn-secondary',
	ghost: 'shadcn-btn-ghost',
	link: 'shadcn-btn-link',
};

const SIZE_CLASSES = {
	default: 'shadcn-btn-size-default',
	sm: 'shadcn-btn-sm',
	lg: 'shadcn-btn-lg',
	icon: 'shadcn-btn-icon',
};

export default function save(props) {
	const {
		anchor,
		localId,
		animation,
		interactionLayers,
		styleAttributes,
		// Button specific
		text,
		variant,
		size,
		href,
		target,
		rel,
		disabled,
		fullWidth,
		icon,
		iconPosition,
	} = props.attributes;

	let DynamicDataAttributes = getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props);
	let AnimationProps = AnimationRenderProps(animation, interactionLayers);

	// Build button classes
	const buttonClasses = [
		'shadcn-btn',
		VARIANT_CLASSES[variant] || VARIANT_CLASSES.default,
		SIZE_CLASSES[size] || SIZE_CLASSES.default,
		fullWidth ? 'shadcn-btn-full' : '',
		disabled ? 'shadcn-btn-disabled' : '',
		props.attributes.className || '',
	].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

	// Determine element tag based on href
	const ElementTag = href ? 'a' : 'button';

	const blockProps = {
		...DynamicDataAttributes,
		...AnimationProps,
		className: buttonClasses,
	};

	// Add localId for styling
	if (localId && (styleAttributes || !isEqual(animation, attributes.animation.default))) {
		blockProps.className = blockProps.className + ' ' + localId;
	}

	// Add anchor if set
	if (anchor) {
		blockProps.id = anchor;
	}

	// Add link attributes
	if (href) {
		blockProps.href = href;
		if (target && target !== '_self') {
			blockProps.target = target;
		}
		if (rel) {
			blockProps.rel = rel;
		}
	}

	// Add disabled state
	if (disabled) {
		if (href) {
			blockProps['aria-disabled'] = 'true';
		} else {
			blockProps.disabled = true;
		}
	}

	// Add button type if not a link
	if (!href) {
		blockProps.type = 'button';
	}

	// Render icon box
	let iconBox = icon ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(icon)) : null;

	return (
		<ElementTag {...blockProps}>
			{iconBox && iconPosition === 'left' && (
				<SVGViewer attributeName="icon" attributeText="textPathAttributes" blockProps={blockProps} {...props} />
			)}
			<RichText.Content value={text} />
			{iconBox && iconPosition === 'right' && (
				<SVGViewer attributeName="icon" attributeText="textPathAttributes" blockProps={blockProps} {...props} />
			)}
		</ElementTag>
	);
}

```

```php
<?php
/**
 * Shadcn Button Block - Server-side Rendering
 *
 * @package AltitudeBlocks
 */

namespace AltitudeBlocks\Blocks;

defined('ABSPATH') || exit;

class ButtonBlock
{
	/**
	 * Variant class mappings
	 */
	private static $variant_classes = array(
		'default' => 'shadcn-btn-default',
		'destructive' => 'shadcn-btn-destructive',
		'outline' => 'shadcn-btn-outline',
		'secondary' => 'shadcn-btn-secondary',
		'ghost' => 'shadcn-btn-ghost',
		'link' => 'shadcn-btn-link',
	);

	/**
	 * Size class mappings
	 */
	private static $size_classes = array(
		'default' => 'shadcn-btn-size-default',
		'sm' => 'shadcn-btn-sm',
		'lg' => 'shadcn-btn-lg',
		'icon' => 'shadcn-btn-icon',
	);

	public function __construct()
	{
		add_action('init', array($this, 'init_handler'));
	}

	public function init_handler()
	{
		register_block_type(__DIR__, array(
			'render_callback' => array($this, 'render_block'),
		));
	}

	public function render_block($settings, $inner_content, $block)
	{
		$block = (is_array($block)) ? $block : $block->parsed_block;
		$attrs = $block['attrs'];

		// Support for Hide on Frontend option
		if (!empty($attrs['styleAttributes']['hideOnFrontend_Extra'])) {
			if (!is_admin()) {
				return '';
			}
		}

		// Get attributes with defaults
		$text = !empty($attrs['text']) ? $attrs['text'] : __('Button', 'altitude-blocks');
		$variant = !empty($attrs['variant']) ? $attrs['variant'] : 'default';
		$size = !empty($attrs['size']) ? $attrs['size'] : 'default';
		$href = !empty($attrs['href']) ? $attrs['href'] : '';
		$target = !empty($attrs['target']) ? $attrs['target'] : '_self';
		$rel = !empty($attrs['rel']) ? $attrs['rel'] : '';
		$disabled = !empty($attrs['disabled']) ? $attrs['disabled'] : false;
		$full_width = !empty($attrs['fullWidth']) ? $attrs['fullWidth'] : false;
		$anchor = !empty($attrs['anchor']) ? $attrs['anchor'] : '';
		$local_id = !empty($attrs['localId']) ? $attrs['localId'] : '';
		$class_name = !empty($attrs['className']) ? $attrs['className'] : '';

		// Build classes array
		$classes = array('shadcn-btn');

		// Add variant class
		$classes[] = isset(self::$variant_classes[$variant])
			? self::$variant_classes[$variant]
			: self::$variant_classes['default'];

		// Add size class
		$classes[] = isset(self::$size_classes[$size])
			? self::$size_classes[$size]
			: self::$size_classes['default'];

		// Add full width class
		if ($full_width) {
			$classes[] = 'shadcn-btn-full';
		}

		// Add disabled class
		if ($disabled) {
			$classes[] = 'shadcn-btn-disabled';
		}

		// Add local ID for custom styling
		if ($local_id) {
			$classes[] = $local_id;
		}

		// Add custom className if set
		if ($class_name) {
			$classes[] = $class_name;
		}

		$class_string = implode(' ', array_filter($classes));

		// Handle dynamic placeholders in text
		if (strpos($text, '{{') !== false && function_exists('gl_dynamic_placeholders')) {
			$text = gl_dynamic_placeholders($text);
		}

		// Build output
		if ($href && !$disabled) {
			// Render as anchor tag
			$output = sprintf(
				'<a href="%s" class="%s"%s%s%s>%s</a>',
				esc_url($href),
				esc_attr($class_string),
				$target !== '_self' ? sprintf(' target="%s"', esc_attr($target)) : '',
				$rel ? sprintf(' rel="%s"', esc_attr($rel)) : '',
				$anchor ? sprintf(' id="%s"', esc_attr($anchor)) : '',
				wp_kses_post($text)
			);
		} else {
			// Render as button tag
			$output = sprintf(
				'<button type="button" class="%s"%s%s>%s</button>',
				esc_attr($class_string),
				$disabled ? ' disabled aria-disabled="true"' : '',
				$anchor ? sprintf(' id="%s"', esc_attr($anchor)) : '',
				wp_kses_post($text)
			);
		}

		return $output;
	}
}

new ButtonBlock();

```

### 1.2 Register Shadcn Design Tokens

**Tasks:**

- [x] Register size tokens (radius, spacing)
- [x] Verify tokens appear in Greenshift color/variable pickers (fixed: use HEX for variable_value)

**Design Tokens to Register:**
\```php
// Colors
--background, --foreground
--primary, --primary-foreground
--secondary, --secondary-foreground
--destructive, --destructive-foreground
--muted, --muted-foreground
--accent, --accent-foreground
--border, --ring

// Sizes
--radius
\```

**Filter Format:**
\```php
add_filter('greenshift_global_variables', 'altitude_register_shadcn_tokens');
function altitude_register_shadcn_tokens($variables) {
    $variables[] = [
        'label' => 'Primary',
        'value' => 'var(--primary)',
        'variable' => '--primary',
        'variable_value' => '#171717', // Use HEX for picker preview
        'group' => 'color'
    ];
    // ... more tokens
    return $variables;
}
\```

**Edit Component Structure:**
\```javascript
export default function edit(props) {
    // 1. ID Generation
    useEffect(() => { gspb_setBlockId(props, 2); }, []);

    // 2. CSS Generation
    let final_css = generateButtonCSS(props);
    gspb_Css_Final(id, final_css, props);

    // 3. Block Props
    const blockProps = useBlockProps({...});

    // 4. Render
    return (
        <>
            <Inspector {...props} />
            <BlockToolBar {...props} />
            <ElementTag {...blockProps}>
                <RichText ... />
            </ElementTag>
            <style>{editor_css}</style>
        </>
    );
}
\```

/**
 * Shadcn Button Styles
 *
 * These styles implement Shadcn's button component design system.
 * Uses CSS custom properties defined in tokens.php
 */

/* Base button styles */
.shadcn-btn {
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: center;
	gap: 0.5rem;
	white-space: nowrap;
	border-radius: var(--radius);
	font-size: 0.875rem;
	font-weight: 500;
	line-height: 1.25rem;
	transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow;
	transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
	transition-duration: 150ms;
	outline: none;
	border: none;
	cursor: pointer;
	text-decoration: none;
}

.shadcn-btn:focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
	outline-offset: 2px;
}

.shadcn-btn:disabled,
.shadcn-btn[aria-disabled="true"],
.shadcn-btn-disabled {
	pointer-events: none;
	opacity: 0.5;
}

.shadcn-btn svg {
	pointer-events: none;
	flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Variant: Default */
.shadcn-btn-default {
	background-color: var(--primary);
	color: var(--primary-foreground);
	box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

.shadcn-btn-default:hover {
	background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 90%, black);
}

/* Variant: Destructive */
.shadcn-btn-destructive {
	background-color: var(--destructive);
	color: #fff;
	box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

.shadcn-btn-destructive:hover {
	background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 90%, black);
}

.shadcn-btn-destructive:focus-visible {
	outline-color: var(--destructive);
}

/* Variant: Outline */
.shadcn-btn-outline {
	border: 1px solid var(--input);
	background-color: var(--background);
	box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

.shadcn-btn-outline:hover {
	background-color: var(--accent);
	color: var(--accent-foreground);
}

/* Variant: Secondary */
.shadcn-btn-secondary {
	background-color: var(--secondary);
	color: var(--secondary-foreground);
	box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

.shadcn-btn-secondary:hover {
	background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--secondary) 80%, black);
}

/* Variant: Ghost */
.shadcn-btn-ghost {
	background-color: transparent;
}

.shadcn-btn-ghost:hover {
	background-color: var(--accent);
	color: var(--accent-foreground);
}

/* Variant: Link */
.shadcn-btn-link {
	color: var(--primary);
	text-underline-offset: 4px;
	background-color: transparent;
}

.shadcn-btn-link:hover {
	text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Size: Default */
.shadcn-btn-size-default {
	height: 2.25rem;
	padding-left: 1rem;
	padding-right: 1rem;
	padding-top: 0.5rem;
	padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

/* Size: Small */
.shadcn-btn-sm {
	height: 2rem;
	padding-left: 0.75rem;
	padding-right: 0.75rem;
	border-radius: var(--radius);
	gap: 0.375rem;
	font-size: 0.75rem;
}

/* Size: Large */
.shadcn-btn-lg {
	height: 2.5rem;
	padding-left: 1.5rem;
	padding-right: 1.5rem;
	border-radius: var(--radius);
}

/* Size: Icon */
.shadcn-btn-icon {
	height: 2.25rem;
	width: 2.25rem;
	padding: 0;
}

/* Full Width modifier */
.shadcn-btn-full {
	width: 100%;
}

/**
 * Shadcn Button Block - Inspector Controls
 */

// WordPress dependencies
const { __ } = wp.i18n;
const { InspectorControls } = wp.blockEditor;
const { PanelBody, SelectControl, TextControl, ToggleControl, TextareaControl } = wp.components;
const { useState } = wp.element;
import isEqual from 'lodash/isEqual';
import attributesDefault from './attributes';

// Greenlight dependencies
const {
	Animation,
	InteractionsPanel,
	IconPicker,
	AttributeTabs,
} = gspblib.collections;
const { GlobalClasses, BlpgeColorPicker } = gspblib.components;
const { collectionsObjects } = gspblib.helpers;

// Variant options
const VARIANT_OPTIONS = [
	{ label: __('Default', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'default' },
	{ label: __('Destructive', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'destructive' },
	{ label: __('Outline', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'outline' },
	{ label: __('Secondary', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'secondary' },
	{ label: __('Ghost', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'ghost' },
	{ label: __('Link', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'link' },
];

// Size options
const SIZE_OPTIONS = [
	{ label: __('Default', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'default' },
	{ label: __('Small', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'sm' },
	{ label: __('Large', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'lg' },
	{ label: __('Icon', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'icon' },
];

// Icon position options
const ICON_POSITION_OPTIONS = [
	{ label: __('Left', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'left' },
	{ label: __('Right', 'altitude-blocks'), value: 'right' },
];

const Inspector = (props) => {
	const {
		attributes: {
			anchor,
			styleAttributes,
			enableSpecificity,
			staticLocalId,
			// Button specific
			text,
			variant,
			size,
			href,
			target,
			rel,
			disabled,
			fullWidth,
			icon,
			iconPosition,
			textColor,
			iconColor,
			iconSize,
		},
		setAttributes,
	} = props;

	const iconBox = icon ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(icon)) : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(collectionsObjects.iconPicker));

	let animationchange = isEqual(attributesDefault.animation.default, props.attributes.animation) ? false : true;
	let interactionchange = (typeof props.attributes.interactionLayers != 'undefined' && props.attributes.interactionLayers.length > 0) ? true : false;

	return (
		<>
			<InspectorControls>
				<div className="gspb_inspector gst-elements-inspector glfw-inspector">
					<GlobalClasses flexChild={true} {...props} />

					{/* Button Settings Panel */}
					<PanelBody title={__('Button Settings', 'altitude-blocks')} initialOpen={true}>
						<TextControl
							label={__('Button Text', 'altitude-blocks')}
							value={text}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ text: value })}
							placeholder={__('Enter button text...', 'altitude-blocks')}
						/>
						<SelectControl
							label={__('Variant', 'altitude-blocks')}
							value={variant}
							options={VARIANT_OPTIONS}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ variant: value })}
							help={__('Choose the button style variant.', 'altitude-blocks')}
						/>
						<SelectControl
							label={__('Size', 'altitude-blocks')}
							value={size}
							options={SIZE_OPTIONS}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ size: value })}
						/>
						<ToggleControl
							label={__('Full Width', 'altitude-blocks')}
							checked={fullWidth}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ fullWidth: value })}
						/>
						<ToggleControl
							label={__('Disabled', 'altitude-blocks')}
							checked={disabled}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ disabled: value })}
						/>
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Colors Panel */}
					<PanelBody title={__('Colors', 'altitude-blocks')} initialOpen={false}>
						<div className="gspb-inspector-flex-row gs-flex-space-between gs-gutter-10 gs-child-width-9/3 gs-inspector-margin-bottom-10 gs-flex-align-center">
							<div>{__('Text Color', 'altitude-blocks')}</div>
							<div className="gspb_text_align_right">
								<BlpgeColorPicker
									color={textColor}
									onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ textColor: value })}
								/>
							</div>
						</div>
						<div className="gspb-inspector-flex-row gs-flex-space-between gs-gutter-10 gs-child-width-9/3 gs-inspector-margin-bottom-10 gs-flex-align-center">
							<div>{__('Icon Color', 'altitude-blocks')}</div>
							<div className="gspb_text_align_right">
								<BlpgeColorPicker
									color={iconColor}
									onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ iconColor: value })}
								/>
							</div>
						</div>
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Link Settings Panel */}
					<PanelBody title={__('Link Settings', 'altitude-blocks')} initialOpen={false}>
						<TextControl
							label={__('URL', 'altitude-blocks')}
							value={href}
							onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ href: value })}
							placeholder="https://"
						/>
						<ToggleControl
							label={__('Open in new tab', 'altitude-blocks')}
							checked={target === '_blank'}
							onChange={(value) => {
								setAttributes({
									target: value ? '_blank' : '_self',
									rel: value ? 'noopener noreferrer' : '',
								});
							}}
						/>
						{target === '_blank' && (
							<TextControl
								label={__('Rel attribute', 'altitude-blocks')}
								value={rel}
								onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ rel: value })}
								help={__('Default: noopener noreferrer', 'altitude-blocks')}
							/>
						)}
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Icon Settings Panel */}
					<PanelBody title={__('Icon', 'altitude-blocks')} initialOpen={false}>
						<IconPicker
							icon={iconBox}
							options={false}
							{...props}
							onChange={(icon) => {
								setAttributes({ icon: icon });
							}}
						/>
						{icon && (
							<>
								<SelectControl
									label={__('Icon Position', 'altitude-blocks')}
									value={iconPosition}
									options={ICON_POSITION_OPTIONS}
									onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ iconPosition: value })}
								/>
								<TextControl
									label={__('Icon Size', 'altitude-blocks')}
									value={iconSize || '1em'}
									onChange={(value) => setAttributes({ iconSize: value })}
									help={__('e.g., 1em, 16px, 1.5rem', 'altitude-blocks')}
								/>
							</>
						)}
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Local Styles Panel */}
					<PanelBody
						title={__('Local Styles', 'altitude-blocks')}
						initialOpen={false}
						className="gst-inspector-tab gst-elements-styles"
					>
						<AttributeTabs
							attributeName="styleAttributes"
							{...props}
							defaultTab=""
							includes={['color', 'spacing', 'border', 'shadow', 'effects', 'responsive']}
							svgcolors={true}
							selfAlign="both"
						/>
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Animation Panel */}
					<PanelBody
						title={__('Animation', 'altitude-blocks')}
						initialOpen={false}
						className={`${!animationchange ? '' : 'gspb_panel_changed'}`}
					>
						<Animation attributeName="animation" {...props} />
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Interaction Layers Panel */}
					<PanelBody
						title={__('Interaction Layers', 'altitude-blocks')}
						initialOpen={false}
						className={`${interactionchange ? 'gspb_panel_changed' : ''}`}
					>
						<InteractionsPanel {...props} />
					</PanelBody>

					{/* Anchor & Root Class Panel */}
					<PanelBody
						title={__('Anchor & Root Class', 'altitude-blocks')}
						initialOpen={false}
						className={`${anchor || staticLocalId ? 'gspb_panel_changed' : ''}`}
					>
						<TextareaControl
							label={__('Anchor', 'altitude-blocks')}
							help={__('Set an anchor (ID) for this element.', 'altitude-blocks')}
							value={anchor}
							onChange={(value) => {
								let newvalue = value.trim();
								setAttributes({ anchor: newvalue });
							}}
						/>
					</PanelBody>
				</div>
			</InspectorControls>
		</>
	);
};

export default Inspector;

```

/**
 * Button Block Attributes
 * @type {Object}
 */
const { collectionsObjects } = gspblib.helpers;

export default {
	// Standard Greenshift attributes
	id: {
		type: 'string',
		default: null,
	},
	localId: {
		type: 'string',
	},
	staticLocalId: {
		type: 'boolean',
	},
	anchor: {
		type: 'string',
	},
	inlineCssStyles: {
		type: 'string',
	},
	dynamicGClasses: {
		type: 'array',
	},
	interactionLayers: {
		type: 'array',
	},
	animation: {
		type: 'object',
		default: collectionsObjects.animation,
	},
	className: {
		type: 'string',
	},
	styleAttributes: {
		type: 'object',
	},
	enableSpecificity: {
		type: 'boolean',
	},

	// Button specific attributes
	text: {
		type: 'string',
		default: 'Button',
		role: 'content',
	},
	variant: {
		type: 'string',
		default: 'default',
	},
	size: {
		type: 'string',
		default: 'default',
	},
	href: {
		type: 'string',
		default: '',
	},
	target: {
		type: 'string',

/**
 * Shadcn Button Block - Edit Component
 */

// WordPress dependencies
const { __ } = wp.i18n;
const { useRef, useEffect } = wp.element;
const { RichText, useBlockProps } = wp.blockEditor;

// Greenlight dependencies
const { gspb_setBlockId, getDataAttributesfromDynamic } = gspblib.utilities;
const {
	aos_animation_cssGen,
	gspb_Css_Final,
	getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses,
	getCssFromStyleAttributes,
} = gspblib.utilities;
const { gspb_cssGen, gspb_convert_styles_for_editor } = gspblib.helpers;
const { BlockToolBar } = gspblib.components;
const { AnimationRenderProps, AnimationWrapper } = gspblib.collections;

// Inspector
import Inspector from './inspector';

// Button variant and size class mappings
const VARIANT_CLASSES = {
	default: 'shadcn-btn-default',
	destructive: 'shadcn-btn-destructive',
	outline: 'shadcn-btn-outline',
	secondary: 'shadcn-btn-secondary',
	ghost: 'shadcn-btn-ghost',
	link: 'shadcn-btn-link',
};

const SIZE_CLASSES = {
	default: 'shadcn-btn-size-default',
	sm: 'shadcn-btn-sm',
	lg: 'shadcn-btn-lg',
	icon: 'shadcn-btn-icon',
};

export default function edit(props) {
	const {
		id,
		localId,
		animation,
		styleAttributes,
		enableSpecificity,
		interactionLayers,
		anchor,
		// Button specific
		text,
		variant,
		size,
		href,
		disabled,
		fullWidth,
		icon,
		iconPosition,
		iconSize,
		textColor,
		iconColor,
	} = props.attributes;

	// Generate Unique ID for The Block
	useEffect(() => {
		gspb_setBlockId(props, 2);
	}, []);

	// Set Root class for the block
	useEffect(() => {
		if (id != null) {
			if (props.attributes.localId && props.attributes.localId == id) {
				// do nothing
			} else {
				if (props.attributes.staticLocalId && props.attributes.localId) {
					// do nothing
				} else {
					props.setAttributes({ localId: id });
				}
			}
		}
	}, [id]);

	// Extract SVG from icon object and store for frontend
	useEffect(() => {
		if (icon && icon.icon) {
			// Store the SVG string for server-side rendering
			props.setAttributes({ iconSvg: icon.icon });
		} else if (!icon) {
			props.setAttributes({ iconSvg: '' });
		}
	}, [icon]);

	// Check if icon has content
	const hasIcon = icon && icon.icon;

	// Render Animation Properties
	const animationRef = useRef();
	let AnimationProps = AnimationRenderProps(animation, interactionLayers);

	// Get Dynamic Data Attributes
	let DynamicDataAttributes = getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props);

	// Build button classes
	const buttonClasses = [
		'shadcn-btn',
		VARIANT_CLASSES[variant] || VARIANT_CLASSES.default,
		SIZE_CLASSES[size] || SIZE_CLASSES.default,
		fullWidth ? 'shadcn-btn-full' : '',
		hasIcon ? 'shadcn-btn-has-icon' : '',
		localId || '',
	].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

	// Set Block Props
	let blockProps = useBlockProps({
		'data-gspb-block-id': props.attributes.id,
		className: `gspb-selector-element ${buttonClasses}`,
		ref: animationRef,
		...DynamicDataAttributes,
		...AnimationProps,
	});

	// CSS Generation
	let css_selector_by_user = '.' + localId;
	let final_css = '';

	// Get Final CSS from Dynamic Local Classes
	final_css = getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, final_css);

	// Get CSS from Style Attributes
	let local_css = '';
	if (styleAttributes) {
		local_css = getCssFromStyleAttributes(styleAttributes, css_selector_by_user, local_css, enableSpecificity);
	}
	if (local_css != '') {
		final_css += local_css;
	}

	// Animation CSS Generation
	final_css = aos_animation_cssGen(animation, css_selector_by_user, final_css, props);

	// Add custom color CSS
	if (textColor) {
		final_css = gspb_cssGen(css_selector_by_user, ['color'], [textColor], final_css);
	}

	// Icon color and size CSS
	if (hasIcon) {
		const iconSelector = css_selector_by_user + ' .shadcn-btn-icon-wrap svg';
		if (iconColor) {
			final_css = gspb_cssGen(iconSelector, ['fill'], [iconColor], final_css);
		}
		if (iconSize) {
			final_css = gspb_cssGen(iconSelector, ['width', 'height'], [iconSize, iconSize], final_css);
		}
	}

	// Determine element tag - use span in editor for proper block behavior
	let ElementTag = 'span';

	if (anchor) {
		blockProps.id = anchor;
	}

	if (disabled) {
		blockProps['aria-disabled'] = 'true';
		blockProps.className += ' shadcn-btn-disabled';
	}

	// Get Final CSS for Editor
	let editor_css = final_css;
	editor_css = gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(editor_css);

	// Set Stored CSS
	gspb_Css_Final(id, final_css, props);

	// Render icon
	const renderIcon = () => {
		if (!hasIcon) return null;
		return (
			<span
				className="shadcn-btn-icon-wrap"
				dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: icon.icon }}
			/>
		);
	};

	return (
		<>
			<AnimationWrapper attributes={props.attributes} props={props} animationExtRef={animationRef}>
				{props.isSelected && (
					<>
						<Inspector {...props} />
						<BlockToolBar {...props} />
					</>
				)}
				<ElementTag {...blockProps}>
					{hasIcon && iconPosition === 'left' && renderIcon()}
					<RichText
						tagName="span"
						className="shadcn-btn-text"
						placeholder={__('Button text...', 'altitude-blocks')}
						value={text}
						onChange={(value) => {
							props.setAttributes({ text: value });
						}}
						allowedFormats={['core/bold', 'core/italic']}
					/>
					{hasIcon && iconPosition === 'right' && renderIcon()}
					{editor_css && (
						<style
							dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
								__html: editor_css,
							}}
						/>
					)}
				</ElementTag>
			</AnimationWrapper>
		</>
	);
}

```
