<?php
/**
 * Shadcn Button Block - Server-side Rendering
 *
 * @package AltitudeBlocks
 */

namespace AltitudeBlocks\Blocks;

defined('ABSPATH') || exit;

class ButtonBlock
{
	/**
	 * Variant class mappings
	 */
	private static $variant_classes = array(
		'default' => 'shadcn-btn-default',
		'destructive' => 'shadcn-btn-destructive',
		'outline' => 'shadcn-btn-outline',
		'secondary' => 'shadcn-btn-secondary',
		'ghost' => 'shadcn-btn-ghost',
		'link' => 'shadcn-btn-link',
	);

	/**
	 * Size class mappings
	 */
	private static $size_classes = array(
		'default' => 'shadcn-btn-size-default',
		'sm' => 'shadcn-btn-sm',
		'lg' => 'shadcn-btn-lg',
		'icon' => 'shadcn-btn-icon',
	);

	public function __construct()
	{
		add_action('init', array($this, 'init_handler'));
	}

	public function init_handler()
	{
		register_block_type(__DIR__, array(
			'render_callback' => array($this, 'render_block'),
		));
	}

	public function render_block($settings, $inner_content, $block)
	{
		$block = (is_array($block)) ? $block : $block->parsed_block;
		$attrs = $block['attrs'];

		// Support for Hide on Frontend option
		if (!empty($attrs['styleAttributes']['hideOnFrontend_Extra'])) {
			if (!is_admin()) {
				return '';
			}
		}

		// Get attributes with defaults
		$text = !empty($attrs['text']) ? $attrs['text'] : __('Button', 'altitude-blocks');
		$variant = !empty($attrs['variant']) ? $attrs['variant'] : 'default';
		$size = !empty($attrs['size']) ? $attrs['size'] : 'default';
		$href = !empty($attrs['href']) ? $attrs['href'] : '';
		$target = !empty($attrs['target']) ? $attrs['target'] : '_self';
		$rel = !empty($attrs['rel']) ? $attrs['rel'] : '';
		$disabled = !empty($attrs['disabled']) ? $attrs['disabled'] : false;
		$full_width = !empty($attrs['fullWidth']) ? $attrs['fullWidth'] : false;
		$anchor = !empty($attrs['anchor']) ? $attrs['anchor'] : '';
		$local_id = !empty($attrs['localId']) ? $attrs['localId'] : '';
		$class_name = !empty($attrs['className']) ? $attrs['className'] : '';

		// Icon attributes
		$icon_svg = !empty($attrs['iconSvg']) ? $attrs['iconSvg'] : '';
		$icon_position = !empty($attrs['iconPosition']) ? $attrs['iconPosition'] : 'left';
		$icon_size = !empty($attrs['iconSize']) ? $attrs['iconSize'] : '1em';
		$icon_color = !empty($attrs['iconColor']) ? $attrs['iconColor'] : '';

		// Color attributes
		$text_color = !empty($attrs['textColor']) ? $attrs['textColor'] : '';

		// Build classes array
		$classes = array('shadcn-btn');

		// Add variant class
		$classes[] = isset(self::$variant_classes[$variant])
			? self::$variant_classes[$variant]
			: self::$variant_classes['default'];

		// Add size class
		$classes[] = isset(self::$size_classes[$size])
			? self::$size_classes[$size]
			: self::$size_classes['default'];

		// Add full width class
		if ($full_width) {
			$classes[] = 'shadcn-btn-full';
		}

		// Add disabled class
		if ($disabled) {
			$classes[] = 'shadcn-btn-disabled';
		}

		// Add has-icon class
		if ($icon_svg) {
			$classes[] = 'shadcn-btn-has-icon';
		}

		// Add local ID for custom styling
		if ($local_id) {
			$classes[] = $local_id;
		}

		// Add custom className if set
		if ($class_name) {
			$classes[] = $class_name;
		}

		$class_string = implode(' ', array_filter($classes));

		// Build inline styles
		$styles = array();
		if ($text_color) {
			$styles[] = 'color:' . esc_attr($text_color);
		}

		$style_string = !empty($styles) ? ' style="' . implode(';', $styles) . '"' : '';

		// Handle dynamic placeholders in text
		if (strpos($text, '{{') !== false && function_exists('gl_dynamic_placeholders')) {
			$text = gl_dynamic_placeholders($text);
		}

		// Build icon HTML
		$icon_html = '';
		if ($icon_svg) {
			$icon_styles = array();
			if ($icon_color) {
				$icon_styles[] = 'fill:' . esc_attr($icon_color);
			}
			if ($icon_size && $icon_size !== '1em') {
				$icon_styles[] = 'width:' . esc_attr($icon_size);
				$icon_styles[] = 'height:' . esc_attr($icon_size);
			}
			$icon_style_attr = !empty($icon_styles) ? ' style="' . implode(';', $icon_styles) . '"' : '';

			// Wrap icon SVG
			$icon_html = '<span class="shadcn-btn-icon-wrap">' . $icon_svg . '</span>';

			// If we have icon styles, inject them into the SVG
			if ($icon_style_attr) {
				$icon_html = '<span class="shadcn-btn-icon-wrap"' . $icon_style_attr . '>' . $icon_svg . '</span>';
			}
		}

		// Build content with icon
		$content = '';
		if ($icon_html && $icon_position === 'left') {
			$content .= $icon_html;
		}
		$content .= '<span class="shadcn-btn-text">' . wp_kses_post($text) . '</span>';
		if ($icon_html && $icon_position === 'right') {
			$content .= $icon_html;
		}

		// Build output
		if ($href && !$disabled) {
			// Render as anchor tag
			$output = sprintf(
				'<a href="%s" class="%s"%s%s%s%s>%s</a>',
				esc_url($href),
				esc_attr($class_string),
				$target !== '_self' ? sprintf(' target="%s"', esc_attr($target)) : '',
				$rel ? sprintf(' rel="%s"', esc_attr($rel)) : '',
				$anchor ? sprintf(' id="%s"', esc_attr($anchor)) : '',
				$style_string,
				$content
			);
		} else {
			// Render as button tag
			$output = sprintf(
				'<button type="button" class="%s"%s%s%s>%s</button>',
				esc_attr($class_string),
				$disabled ? ' disabled aria-disabled="true"' : '',
				$anchor ? sprintf(' id="%s"', esc_attr($anchor)) : '',
				$style_string,
				$content
			);
		}

		return $output;
	}
}

Files copied. I've made the following changes to fix the icon issue:

1. **Editor (`edit.js`)**: Now uses `SVGViewer` component (the proper gspblib approach) instead of `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`

2. **Save (`save.js`)**: Uses `SVGViewer` wrapped in the proper `shadcn-btn-icon-wrap` span structure

     1→# Altitude Blocks - Shadcn Design System for Greenshift
     2→
     3→## Important Rules
     4→
     5→1. **Keep PROJECT_PLAN.md in sync**: When completing tasks, always update the checkboxes in `docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md` to track progress between sessions and apps. This ensures continuity across different AI assistants and coding sessions.
     6→
     7→2. **Use Bun for package management**: This project uses Bun instead of npm. Use `bun install`, `bun start`, `bun run build`, etc.
     8→
     9→## Project Overview
    10→
    11→A WordPress block library that brings Shadcn's design system to the Greenshift/GreenLight ecosystem. This plugin registers Shadcn design tokens as Greenshift global variables and provides Shadcn-styled blocks using GreenLight's class-first approach.
    12→
    13→## Quick Reference
    14→
    15→```bash
    16→# Development
    17→bun start          # Start development with hot reload
    18→bun run build      # Production build
    19→
    20→# Key directories
    21→src/blocks/        # Block source files
    22→blockrender/       # Server-side PHP rendering
    23→build/             # Compiled output (auto-generated)
    24→```
    25→
    26→## Architecture Decisions
    27→
    28→### Core Approach
    29→- **GreenLight's class-first approach**: 1 block = 1 HTML tag, clean output
    30→- **Server-side rendering** with `CSSRender: 1` for performance
    31→- **No Tailwind compilation** - leverage GreenLight's class registration system
    32→- **Design tokens via PHP filters** - not JavaScript/CSS imports
    33→
    34→### Key PHP Filters Used
    35→1. `greenshift_global_variables` - Register Shadcn CSS custom properties
    36→2. `greenshift_preset_classes` - Register component class presets
    37→
    38→### Design Token Format
    39→```php
    40→// Variables (colors, sizes)
    41→['label' => 'Name', 'value' => 'var(--name)', 'variable' => '--name', 'variable_value' => 'oklch(value)', 'group' => 'color']
    42→
    43→// Preset classes
    44→['value' => 'classname', 'label' => 'Display Name', 'type' => 'preset', 'css' => '.classname{styles}']
    45→```
    46→
    47→## Block Development Pattern
    48→
    49→### File Structure (per block)
    50→```
    51→src/blocks/[blockname]/
    52→├── index.js          # Block registration
    53→├── edit.js           # Editor component
    54→├── save.js           # Frontend save (minimal)
    55→├── inspector.js      # InspectorControls
    56→├── attributes.js     # Block attributes schema
    57→├── icon.js           # Block icon SVG
    58→└── styles.editor.scss # Editor-only styles
    59→
    60→blockrender/[blockname]/
    61→├── block.json        # Block metadata
    62→└── block.php         # Server-side render callback
    63→```
    64→
    65→### Required Attributes (every block)
    66→```javascript
    67→{
    68→    id: { type: 'string', default: null },
    69→    localId: { type: 'string' },
    70→    inlineCssStyles: { type: 'string' },
    71→    styleAttributes: { type: 'object' },
    72→    animation: { type: 'object', default: collectionsObjects.animation }
    73→}
    74→```
    75→
    76→### ID Generation Pattern
    77→```javascript
    78→useEffect(() => {
    79→    gspb_setBlockId(props, 2);
    80→}, []);
    81→```
    82→
    83→### CSS Generation Pipeline
    84→```javascript
    85→let css_selector = '.' + localId;
    86→let final_css = '';
    87→
    88→// 1. Dynamic local classes
    89→final_css = getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, final_css);
    90→
    91→// 2. Style attributes (responsive)
    92→final_css = getCssFromStyleAttributes(styleAttributes, css_selector, final_css, enableSpecificity);
    93→
    94→// 3. Custom properties (responsive - 4 breakpoints)
    95→final_css = gspb_cssGen(css_selector, ['property'], [[desktop, tablet, mobileL, mobileP]], final_css);
    96→
    97→// 4. Non-responsive properties
    98→final_css = gspb_cssGen(css_selector, ['property'], [value], final_css);
    99→
   100→// 5. Store for output
   101→gspb_Css_Final(id, final_css, props);
   102→```
   103→
   104→## Shadcn Design Tokens
   105→
   106→### Colors (OKLCH format)
   107→```css
   108→--background: oklch(1 0 0);
   109→--foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
   110→--primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
   111→--primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
   112→--secondary: oklch(0.97 0 0);
   113→--secondary-foreground: oklch(0.205 0 0);
   114→--destructive: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325);
   115→--destructive-foreground: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325);
   116→--muted: oklch(0.97 0 0);
   117→--muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
   118→--accent: oklch(0.97 0 0);
   119→--accent-foreground: oklch(0.205 0 0);
   120→--border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
   121→--ring: oklch(0.708 0 0);
   122→--radius: 0.625rem;
   123→```
   124→
   125→## Button Component Reference
   126→
   127→### Variants (6)
   128→| Variant | Description |
   129→|---------|-------------|
   130→| default | Primary background, primary-foreground text |
   131→| destructive | Destructive background, destructive-foreground text |
   132→| outline | Border only, background on hover |
   133→| secondary | Secondary background, secondary-foreground text |
   134→| ghost | Transparent, background on hover |
   135→| link | Text only with underline on hover |
   136→
   137→### Sizes (4)
   138→| Size | Dimensions |
   139→|------|------------|
   140→| default | h-9 px-4 py-2 |
   141→| sm | h-8 px-3 text-xs |
   142→| lg | h-10 px-6 |
   143→| icon | h-9 w-9 (square) |
   144→
   145→## Greenshift Library (gspblib) Reference
   146→
   147→### Utilities
   148→- `gspb_setBlockId(props, prefix)` - Generate unique ID
   149→- `getDataAttributesfromDynamic(props)` - Data attributes from class panel
   150→- `getFinalCssFromDynamicLocalClasses(props, css)` - CSS from global classes
   151→- `getCssFromStyleAttributes(attrs, selector, css, specificity)` - CSS from styleAttributes
   152→- `gspb_Css_Final(id, css, props)` - Store CSS for output
   153→
   154→### Helpers
   155→- `gspb_cssGen(selector, properties, values, css)` - Generate responsive CSS
   156→- `gspb_convert_styles_for_editor(css)` - Convert for editor scoping
   157→- `collectionsObjects` - Default attribute objects
   158→
   159→### Components
   160→- `BlockToolBar` - Floating toolbar
   161→- `BlpgeColorPicker` - Color picker with presets
   162→- `UnitControl` - Unit control with variables
   163→- `Devices` - Breakpoint selector
   164→- `GlobalClasses` - Global class picker
   165→
   166→### Collections
   167→- `AnimationWrapper` - Animation context wrapper
   168→- `AnimationRenderProps` - Animation data attributes
   169→- `AttributeTabs` - Full styling tabs
   170→- `IconPicker` - SVG icon picker
   171→
   172→## Dependencies
   173→
   174→### Required Plugins
   175→- **Greenshift** or **GreenLight Builder** (parent plugin)
   176→
   177→### WordPress Dependencies (editor)
   178→```javascript
   179→['greenShift-editor-js', 'greenShift-library-script', 'wp-block-editor', 'wp-blocks', 'wp-i18n', 'wp-element', 'wp-editor', 'wp-data']
   180→```
   181→
   182→## Project Status
   183→

   194→
   195→### Planned Components

   206→## Resources

   209→- [Adding Blocks Programmatically](https://greenshiftwp.com/adding-blocks-programatically-in-greenshift/)

   217→## Development Notes

   220→1. Create directory: `src/blocks/[blockname]/`
   221→2. Create files: index.js, edit.js, save.js, inspector.js, attributes.js, icon.js
   222→3. Create server-side: `blockrender/[blockname]/block.json`, `block.php`

   217→## Current Debug Notes (Button Block)

   219→### Known Issues Being Debugged

   222→2. **CSS file location**: Button styles are in `assets/css/button.css` and enqueued via `render_block` filter in `altitude-blocks.php`

   224→### Button Block Architecture
   225→
   226→**Hybrid Rendering Approach**:
   227→- Buttons WITH icons use `save.js` output (passed through `$inner_content` in PHP) because `SVGViewer` component handles icon rendering
   228→- Buttons WITHOUT icons use full server-side rendering in `block.php`
   229→- This is determined in `block.php:60-72`
   230→
   231→**Icon Handling**:
   232→- Icons use `SVGViewer` component from `gspblib.components`
   233→- Do NOT pass `blockProps` to SVGViewer - it applies parent classes to the SVG
   234→- Icon is wrapped in `<span class="shadcn-btn-icon-wrap">`
   235→
   236→**CSS Specificity for Overrides**:
   237→- Custom styles (font-size, color, icon-size) use selector `.shadcn-btn.{localId}` for higher specificity
   238→- This is set in `edit.js:152-153`: `const btn_selector = '.shadcn-btn' + css_selector_by_user;`
   239→
   240→**Key Files**:
   241→- `src/blocks/button/edit.js` - Editor component, CSS generation
   242→- `src/blocks/button/save.js` - Frontend save (used for icon buttons)
   243→- `src/blocks/button/inspector.js` - Settings panels
   244→- `src/blocks/button/attributes.js` - Block attributes
   245→- `blockrender/button/block.php` - Server-side rendering
   246→- `assets/css/button.css` - Button styles
   247→
   248→**Inspector Panels**:
   249→- Button Settings (text, variant, size, full width, disabled)
   250→- Typography (font size)
   251→- Colors (text color, icon color)
   252→- Link Settings (URL, target, rel)
